title: Distinguish retained verification bodies from pre-freeze record-format injection
outcome: A fresh owner-backed verification run cannot select a historical Commit wire format merely from a pre-existing body file, while genuine retained historical bodies replay unchanged.
acceptance: Fresh source-backed registrations select complete owner source format independently of an unproven pre-existing Commit body.

Historical bodies with established replay provenance remain byte-preserved; behavior fixtures discriminate fresh planted format from genuine retained replay without adding authority or credit conditions.
